WITH patient_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    l.ID,
    p.SEX,
    AVG(l.PT) as avg_pt,
    AVG(CASE WHEN l.IGA IS NOT NULL AND l.IGM IS NOT NULL THEN l.IGA - l.IGM END) as avg_iga_igm
  FROM Laboratory l
  INNER JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
  GROUP BY l.ID, p.SEX
),
overall_mean_value AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_iga_igm) as overall_mean_iga_igm
  FROM patient_stats
),
patient_with_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    ps.SEX,
    ps.avg_pt,
    ps.avg_iga_igm,
    CASE 
      WHEN ps.avg_iga_igm IS NOT NULL AND omv.overall_mean_iga_igm IS NOT NULL
      THEN ps.avg_iga_igm / omv.overall_mean_iga_igm
      ELSE NULL
    END as ratio_to_overall_mean
  FROM patient_stats ps
  CROSS JOIN overall_mean_value omv
)
SELECT 
  SEX,
  AVG(avg_pt) as avg_pt_all_patients,
  AVG(avg_iga_igm) as avg_iga_igm_all_patients,
  AVG(ratio_to_overall_mean) as avg_ratio_to_overall_mean
FROM patient_with_ratios
GROUP BY SEX
ORDER BY SEX
